values.title: Why we generate types from schemas, not the other way around
values.summary: The design decision behind Tessera’s type system.
values.body:
## Start from the data

Most backends define types in code and hope the database agrees. Tessera reverses that: the schema is the single source of truth, and everything else, from the database to your client types, is derived from it.

That means a type can never drift from the table it describes. Change a column and the compiler shows you exactly what breaks.

## Why it matters

Generated types remove a whole class of bugs, and they remove the boilerplate that keeps them in sync. You spend your time on the product instead of on glue.
